correctness.rationale: For Bloch H(z) with H_AB=p+sz,H_BA=p+sz^{-1}, H_AC=r,H_BC=q and diagonals QA,QB,QC, the exact Laurent coefficient of z+z^-1 in det(H−E) is s(qr−p(QC−E)); as s,p>0, a flat band forces E=QC−g, g=qr/p>0. At that energy, the Schur complement of C is [[alpha,sz],[sz^-1,beta]] with alpha=QA−QC+g−pr/q and beta=QB−QC+g−pq/r. Its determinant alpha*beta−s² gives iff flat locus. With alpha*beta=s² both have same nonzero sign. Sylvester inertia with positive g places zero eigenvalue at bottom for alpha>0 and middle for alpha<0; rank 2 for all Bloch phases and compact unit circle imply positive isolation. Exact Laurent nullvector (−sz,alpha,(rsz−q alpha)/g) is nowhere zero and provides two-cell CLS spanning the infinite eigenspace by Laurent polynomial density. Independent SymPy determinant, nullvector and polynomial equalities passed.
risk: Isolation bound depends on fixed parameters; no uniform gap over full quadric; finite Bloch samples alone would be insufficient.
